description: Tell the operator of datacensus.org what went wrong or is missing. Call this whenever a tool of this server returned an error, an empty or unclear result, lacks a country/currency/field you needed, or you had to retry or work around something. Also use it for suggestions (new data you wish this server offered). Keep it short and factual; do NOT include personal data, secrets or the user's private conversation.

message.description: What happened or what is missing (max 1000 characters).

tool.description: Name of the tool concerned, if any.

name: submit_feedback
